deployment_policy.switch_rule: Do not replace/restart the active production RemoteMCP for this redesign until the remaining planned phases are complete, an explicit release-QA gate passes, and the owner explicitly authorizes deployment.
deployment_policy.reason: Other active research projects depend on the currently running remote.

identity.principal_key: Exact implementation source: mcp.server.auth.middleware.auth_context.get_access_token().client_id. Missing access token => AUTH_REQUIRED. Never caller-supplied.
identity.agent_id: Server-generated stable logical agent id, prefix agt_.
identity.client_instance_id: Caller-generated stable opaque identifier unique within principal_key; required for reconnect identity.
identity.session_id: Server-generated per registration/resume session id, prefix ses_.
identity.session_rule: One logical agent may have multiple sessions, but one task lease is owned by exactly one session at a time.
identity.agent_register_idempotency: Same principal_key + client_instance_id resolves the same agent_id; every successful registration creates a new session_id.

claim_protocol: create lease_epoch = previous + 1 and new random lease_token
return lease_token exactly once in claim result
complete_preconditions: valid current lease token and epoch
no non-terminal V2-A jobs bound to task_id
Git worktree has no uncommitted changes unless completion contract explicitly records an allowed dirty result; v1 prelock chooses clean/committed only
task.blocked_rule: BLOCKED has no active task lease. Blocking releases the task lease but preserves workspace and durable jobs.
task.recoverable_rule: RECOVERABLE preserves workspace, checkpoints and durable jobs and may be claimed by another session.

heartbeat_and_lease.lease_token_storage: Clear token is never persisted. task_leases stores lease_token_nonce + sha256(token). Token is reproducibly derived with a runtime-local HMAC key for safe claim-response replay.
heartbeat_and_lease.lease_epoch: Monotonic integer per task; every claim/takeover increments it.

heartbeat_protocol.heartbeat_seq: Strictly monotonic integer per session; duplicate seq is idempotent, lower seq rejected.
heartbeat_protocol.renews: All unexpired task/path leases owned by the exact session, up to their configured TTL.
heartbeat_protocol.operation_id_exception: Heartbeat uses monotonic heartbeat_seq instead of the V2-A operations table to avoid unbounded operation-row growth.

expiry.session: ACTIVE -> STALE when now - last_heartbeat_at > task_lease_ttl_seconds.
expiry.task_claimed_or_running: CLAIMED/RUNNING -> RECOVERABLE when the owning task lease expires.
expiry.old_agent_after_takeover: Any mutation carrying an old lease_token or lease_epoch is rejected with LEASE_STALE.

takeover.behavior: New claim increments lease_epoch and returns a new token. Previous token never becomes valid again.

lease_token_derivation.create_rule: Create once atomically before V2-B service accepts mutations; fail closed if active leases exist but the key is missing or unreadable.
lease_token_derivation.token_nonce: Server-generated random URL-safe nonce stored in task_leases.lease_token_nonce.
lease_token_derivation.replay_rule: A replay of the same successful task_claim may re-derive the same clear token only while that exact lease epoch/owner/session is still current; otherwise LEASE_STALE.

project_concurrency.git_project_rule: Parallel tasks are allowed only in distinct task worktrees.
project_concurrency.non_git_rule: Parallel mutation requires non-overlapping explicit path leases.
project_concurrency.convergence_rule: No automatic merge to main/default branch in V2-B. Convergence is an explicit later operation outside the task-worktree mutation path.

git_worktree.base_binding: Task creation freezes base_ref and resolves exact base_commit before any claim.
git_worktree.create_rule: First claim creates branch/worktree from frozen base_commit; later takeover reuses the same task branch/worktree when identity checks pass.
validation: project root is a Git worktree/repository
task worktree path is under workspace ROOT
branch is exactly the task branch recorded in DB
HEAD belongs to the recorded task branch
worktree is not owned by another non-terminal task

eligible_when: no non-terminal jobs bound to task
cleanup.recovery: Never git worktree prune blindly. Reconcile DB task/worktree records against git worktree list and preserve ambiguous entries.

git_worktree.main_tree_protection: V2-B task mutations never target the project's main working tree; they target the task worktree.

non_git_leases.mutation_requires: WRITE_EXCLUSIVE path lease plus current task lease.
non_git_leases.hierarchical_conflict: TREE lease conflicts with any overlapping descendant/ancestor write lease. FILE lease conflicts with same file and any ancestor TREE write lease.
non_git_leases.path_normalization: Resolve canonical path under registered project root and workspace ROOT before conflict check.
non_git_leases.expiry: Path lease expires with its owning session/task lease and is never transferred; takeover must acquire fresh path lease(s).

cas_mutation.managed_project_policy: Direct managed file mutations must use file_write_cas/file_edit_cas. Legacy write_file/edit_file are rejected with LEASE_REQUIRED_USE_CAS when the resolved path is inside a registered project root or a registered task worktree.
cas_mutation.unmanaged_compatibility: Legacy write_file/edit_file retain V2-A behavior for paths not covered by a registered V2-B project.
write_contract: for non-Git, validate overlapping path lease
reject mismatch with CAS_MISMATCH and do not write
write unique temp file in same directory
persist operation result with before_hash and after_hash
cas_mutation.edit_contract: UTF-8 text edit, expected_sha256 mandatory, old must occur exactly expected_occurrences times (default 1), then the same atomic CAS write contract applies.
cas_mutation.symlink_policy: Resolve and reject escapes before hash/write. Do not follow a symlink outside the task/project root.
cas_mutation.binary_write_v2b: file_write_cas accepts UTF-8 string content only in V2-B; binary artifact mutation is deferred.

crash_reconcile.PREPARED: If current hash is expected_before_hash and temp exists with intended_after_hash, replacement may resume. If current hash is intended_after_hash, advance to REPLACED. Any other current hash => operation IN_DOUBT and preserve temp/evidence.
crash_reconcile.REPLACED: If current hash is intended_after_hash, persist operation result and COMMITTED. Otherwise => IN_DOUBT.
crash_reconcile.COMMITTED: Replay persisted operation result; no filesystem write.
crash_reconcile.ABORTED: No automatic retry unless operation state is FAILED_RETRYABLE and current hash still matches expected_before_hash.

intent_journal.result_contract: Persist before_hash, after_hash, path_rel and task_id in operation result.

v2a_job_interaction.rule: Durable V2-A jobs are independent of agent/session/task lease lifetime once successfully launched.
v2a_job_interaction.on_task_lease_expiry: Task becomes RECOVERABLE; job continues; workspace is preserved.
v2a_job_interaction.new_claimant: May inspect jobs bound to task and may request cancellation only with the current task lease through task_job_cancel.
v2a_job_interaction.stale_agent: May read public status if authorized by principal policy but cannot mutate/cancel through task-scoped tools after takeover.
v2a_job_interaction.task_completion: Rejected while any job bound to task_id is non-terminal.
v2a_job_interaction.blocked_task_with_job: Allowed; BLOCKED releases lease while durable job continues.
v2a_job_interaction.direct_v2a_job_submit_policy: Once at least one V2-B project is registered, direct job_submit is disabled with TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. All new durable execution uses task_job_submit so task/worktree binding cannot be bypassed by argv path arguments.
v2a_job_interaction.direct_v2a_job_cancel_policy: For any job bound to a V2-B task, direct job_cancel is rejected with TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. Use task_job_cancel with the current task lease.
v2a_job_interaction.legacy_run_command_policy: Once at least one V2-B project is registered, legacy run_command is disabled with TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED because argv may mutate managed projects outside file guards. task_job_submit is the managed execution path.
v2a_job_interaction.non_git_task_job_policy: task_job_submit for NON_GIT projects requires the current task/session to hold a TREE WRITE_EXCLUSIVE path lease on project root '.'. This serializes process-level mutation for non-Git projects.
v2a_job_interaction.process_isolation_limit: V2-B does not OS-sandbox arbitrary allowed executables. Isolation guarantees assume task-bound commands operate within their assigned worktree/project scope; absolute-path behavior outside that scope remains owner-trusted and is covered by release QA/documented limitations.

tool_rules.heartbeat_exception: agent_heartbeat is the only mutating V2-B tool without operation_id; heartbeat_seq supplies monotonic idempotency.
tool_rules.lease_token_return: Only task_claim returns the clear lease_token. Status/checkpoint/events never echo it.
tool_rules.secrets: Clear lease tokens are never persisted or logged.

identity: same principal+client_instance resolves same agent and new session
different principals cannot reuse agent/session identity
heartbeat duplicate seq idempotent; lower seq rejected
lease_races: two agents claim same READY task concurrently: exactly one lease wins
lease expiry transitions RUNNING to RECOVERABLE exactly once
takeover increments lease_epoch and invalidates old token
late heartbeat from old session cannot resurrect expired lease
release vs expiry race produces one recoverable state
project_concurrency: BLOCKED and RECOVERABLE do not consume active slot
parallel tasks in same Git project receive distinct worktrees
git_worktree: takeover reuses same worktree and branch
dirty terminal worktree is preserved, never auto-deleted
ambiguous git worktree reconciliation preserves data
non_git: overlapping TREE/FILE write lease conflict detection
non-overlapping path leases can run concurrently
cas: matching hash writes atomically and returns before/after hashes
MISSING creates only when path absent
concurrent CAS writers: exactly one succeeds from same expected hash
edit occurrence mismatch performs zero write
legacy write/edit rejected inside managed registered project
crash after replace before operation result reconciles through cas_mutations without second write
claim response replay re-derives same lease token without persisted clear token
durable_job: task job survives session heartbeat loss
task lease expiry does not cancel payload
current lease can cancel job through task_job_cancel
task completion rejected while bound job non-terminal
direct V2-A job_submit/cancel rejected for managed task/project paths
legacy run_command rejected once managed mode is active
direct V2-A job_submit rejected once any V2-B project is registered
NON_GIT task_job_submit requires project-root TREE write lease
crash_recovery: server crash after task CLAIMED before worktree creation
server crash after worktree creation before RUNNING
server crash after lease persisted before response
server crash during CAS after temp write before replace
server crash after replace before operation result persistence
server restart with expired leases marks tasks RECOVERABLE without killing jobs
test_matrix.scale_smoke: At least 3 agents across at least 2 projects, including 2 concurrent tasks in one Git project, must qualify.

observability_successor.timing: After V2-B identity/task semantics are implemented and qualified; may be done before or alongside V2-C, but not inside this prelock.

design.ui: Read-only owner-authenticated endpoint/view, suggested /ops with JSON API under /ops/api.
design.live_behavior: Bounded polling/SSE may be added later; UI must not require holding agent MCP context.
security: no command execution from dashboard in first version
design.rationale: Once multiple agents exist, operational visibility becomes necessary for diagnosing contention, stuck leases, long jobs and project load without consuming agent context.

prelock_amendment.reason: Implementation feasibility review found two correctness gaps before runtime implementation: clear lease-token replay after response loss, and CAS crash recovery after atomic replace before operation result persistence. The prospective schema/spec were amended before implementation lock.
